snippet.text:
theorem sum_char_mul_S {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) {a : ℕ → ℂ}
    (ha : Summable fun n => ‖a n‖) (hcop : ∀ n, a n ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime n q) (β : ℝ) :
    ∑ b : ZMod q, ψ b * expTsum a (b.val / q + β) =
      gaussSum ψ ZMod.stdAddChar * Schar ψ⁻¹ a β := by

proof_context.conclusion: For `aₙ` supported coprime to `q`, `Σ_{b mod q} ψ(b) S(b/q+β) = τ(ψ) S_{ψ⁻¹}(β)`.

theorem norm_sq_gaussSum {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) :
    ‖gaussSum ψ ZMod.stdAddChar‖ ^ 2 =
      if Squarefree (q / ψ.conductor) ∧ Nat.Coprime (q / ψ.conductor) ψ.conductor
      then (ψ.conductor : ℝ) else 0 := by

proof_context.conclusion: For any `ψ` mod `q` with conductor `c`, `|τ(ψ)|² = c` if `q/c` is squarefree and coprime to `c`, else 0, proved via `gauss_induced` and primitive `|τ|²=c`.

proof.summary: The character sum of S(b/q+β) is expressed as a Gauss sum times the twisted sum S_{ψ⁻¹}(β), and |τ(ψ)|² equals the conductor when q/c is squarefree and coprime to c.
